author: reek
body: Flagship correctness test for the Lens planner: the star schema from the Phase 0 spike, a governed model over it, and the queries driven end to end through lens-run. Every expected number is hand-computed in the prose below.

author: reek
body: Orders is the fact, users and regions are the dimension tables, and every join is declared many-to-one so the grain checker may trust it. Regions sits two hops from orders, reached through users, which exercises the join-chain walk. The product dimension on orders puts product-id in the model's vocabulary, and the filter check demands exactly that before a filter may name the column.

author: reek
body: A separate model whose join graph is a diamond: fact f reaches table t through a and through b, every hop many-to-one. Both paths are individually grain-safe, so only the ambiguity rule can refuse the query, and it must, because the two paths can carry different row mappings and the planner never picks between them silently. The model is never executed; lens-plan alone is under test.
